sv.title: Ny vändning i skattestriden – riskkapitaltoppar krävs på 800 miljoner
sv.summary: Skatteverket tar revansch i den utdragna skattestriden mot sex tidigare toppar och anställda på riskkapitalbolaget 3i. Verkets beslut att upptaxera dem med över 800 miljoner kronor har tidigare underkänts, men nu ger kammarrätten grönt ljus.

en.title: New twist in tax dispute – venture capital bosses required to pay 800 million
en.summary: The Tax Agency is getting its revenge in the protracted tax dispute against six former top executives and employees at venture capital firm 3i. The agency's decision to tax them up by over SEK 800 million has previously been overturned, but now the Administrative Court of Appeal gives the green light.
